0002 · Merge evidence of the same cause

owner j3apyye proposed reviewed 2026-11-04 · 0 days ago

Date: 4 November 2026 · Author: j3apyye, prepared by Codex

Replaces: decision 0001 in this proposed triage revision. The accepted original remains unchanged as history. Publication of this review does not establish that the live support desk has adopted the revision.

Context

Reviewing #4471 shows separate parser and booking-form-hint paths merged under one ticket. Subject matching cannot distinguish them. Conversely, different subjects can describe the same failure path.

Decision

Use subject matches to find candidates, then inspect the tenant’s locale, form version, channel and report body. Merge only when the evidence supports the same cause.

For the modeled date failures, use the shared classifier and tenant directory. A matching classifier result is a starting point: contradictory symptoms need investigation. If the tenant is unknown or a cause cannot be established, keep the report separate and ask for the missing context. Keep report IDs and count distinct IDs once.

Consequences

The desk must read more context before merging. In return, a queued parser fix will not hide a separate form defect. New causes need evidence and a general rule before extending the classifier; do not invent a production cause from an intake tag or a note label.

Executable counterexamples

These examples use the existing classifier. The explorer does not inspect report bodies; it cannot resolve contradictory symptoms by itself.
